Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Paul Stirling and Andy Balbirnie will open the batting for Ireland. Dieter Klein will begin with the new ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

So then, just an update of match number 10 Bahrain vs UAE. Bahrain have posted a total of 172, it was raining boundaries there! Now, if they beat UAE, and Ireland beats Germany here, it will be three teams at 4 points each. Therefore, the team with the better net run rate will go through. So, Ireland will have to win here by a big margin, if they want to be ahead in the qualifying race. Stay tuned for the chase!

Ireland will be mighty pleased with the way they have bowled here! They did not pick up wickets at the start but they surely did not allow the batters to score freely. But, they grabbed wickets in a cluster in the middle overs. Josh Little was the pick of the bowlers, he grabbed 2 wickets and was very economical. Although it is not going to be easy for Ireland, they will have to win here by a big margin to increase their net run rate. They do have a fiery batting line-up and will be hoping they can chase this down with ease.

A top bowling performance from Ireland, they were all over Germany! Ireland were disciplined with their bowling and made sure to pick up wickets at regular interval. But, Germany have done well to cross the 100-run mark. It was looking tough at one point, but a few big blows by Faisal Mubashir helped them get there. Germany face a tough task ahead now.

A bye to end the innings! Little bowls a perfect yorker around leg. Venkatraman Ganesan looks to dig it out but misses. The ball goes through to the keeper and the batters steal a bye as the keeper has a shy at the batter's end. Germany finish with 107/7 after 20 overs.
Back of a length, around off. Faisal Mubashir dabs it to backward point for a single.
A length delivery outside off. Faisal Mubashir lifts this aerially towards deep extra-cover for a couple.
On a length, on middle and leg. Venkatraman Ganesan looks to clip it but misses. The ball hits his pads and goes towards the leg side. A leg bye taken.
A length ball, outside off. Faisal Mubashir cuts it to deep cover for a single.
Short and outside off this time. Faisal Mubashir looks to cut but misses.
A full delivery on middle. Faisal Mubashir pushes it to long on for a single.
Josh Little will bowl the final of the innings!
WIDE! A length delivery and down the leg side this time. Faisal Mubashir looks to clip it but misses.
SIX! This tme a maximum! Good shot and Adair is going for runs again in the final overs. A slower full ball, on middle. Faisal Mubashir gets low and tonks it over long on for a biggie.
FOUR! Faisal Mubashir is moving along nicely here now! Adair bangs this short again around leg. Faisal Mubashir pulls it to deep backward square leg for a boundary.
A fuller delivery on off. Venkatraman Ganesan drives it to long off for a single.
On a length, outside off. Venkatraman Ganesan makes room and looks to cut it towards the off side but misses.
A short delivery on middle. Faisal Mubashir skips down the track and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, on middle. Faisal Mubashir works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played this time! A full toss on off. Faisal Mubashir gets across and scoops it fine towards the long leg fence for a boundary.
A length delivery around off. Faisal Mubashir makes room and looks to hit it towards the off side but misses.
A length delivery on middle. Faisal Mubashir clips it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
On a length, on off. Venkatraman Ganesan punches it to deep point for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Faisal Mubashir pushes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Shorter and outside off this time. Faisal Mubashir cuts it to deep point for a single.
A length delivery on off. Venkatraman Ganesan pushes it to covers for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Faisal Mubashir works it to deep square leg for a single.
Venkatraman Ganesan is the new man in!

OUT! TAKEN! Germany continue to tumble! A nasty short delivery on middle. Fayaz Nasseri looks to pull but is hurried on his pull-shot. He gets the top edge and the ball loops up in the air towards square leg. Andy McBrine runs to his right and takes a fine catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Andy McBrine b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, around off. Fayaz Nasseri slams it towards long on. Tector there fumbles and the batters run couple.
Shorter length delivery outside off. Faisal Mubashir pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Mark Adair comes back into the attack now.
Beaten again! A good-length delivery around off. Fayaz Nasseri tries to block it but gets beaten off the outside edge again.
A length delivery outside off. Fayaz Nasseri drives it away from his body but misses.
On a length, outside off. Fayaz Nasseri looks to drive but misses.

OUT! LBW! Another one bites the dust! Craig Young strikes this time! On a length, shaping back in, on middle. Dieter Klein looks to flick and misses. He gets hit on the pads and the Irish appeal for LBW, the umpire takes his time, but raises his finger at the end. Germany lose their 6th wicket now! Fayaz Nasseri comes to the crease now.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Another Shorter ball, around middle. Dieter Klein pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shorter ball, outside off. Faisal Mubashir taps it towards deep point for a single.
Craig Young (2-0-11-0) comes back on!
Darted on middle and leg. Klein works it to mid-wicket now.
A fuller delivery on off this time. Faisal Mubashir drives it to long off for a single.
A tossed up delivery on off. Klein drives it uppishly towards long off for a single.
A flatter delivery on off. Klein blocks it again.
A slower delivery on off. Klein blocks it out.
Dieter Klein comes to the crease now.

OUT! LBW! Germany lose two in two balls now! A flatter delivery on middle and leg this time. Azam goes back and looks to work it towards the leg side but misses. He is rapped up on the pads and there is an appeal. The umpire raises his finger and Shoaib Azam goes without troubling the scorers.

OUT! TAKEN! This is a big wicket for Ireland and Dylan Alexander Blignaut has to depart after a breezy knock. A shorter delivery outside off. Dylan Alexander Blignaut gets across and looks to pull it over deep mid-wicket. However, he fails to get enough distance and finds Harry Tector at deep. He takes a fine catch near the ropes and Germany lose another wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Tector b Simi Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Shoaib Azam comes to the crease.
WIDE! Outside off this time a bit too wide. Dylan Alexander Blignaut looks to cut but misses.
Tossed up outside off. Dylan Alexander Blignaut goes for a big slog-sweep but misses.
Short and outside off this time. Dylan Alexander Blignaut cuts it to deep point for a couple.
A fuller delivery again on off. Faisal Mubashir drives it to deep cover for a single.
Singh pushes this quicker outside off. Faisal Mubashir looks to drive but misses.
Tossed up outside off. Faisal Mubashir skips down the track and pushes it to covers.
FOUR! Top shot! Dylan Alexander Blignaut is taking charge now! A fuller ball, outside off. Dylan Alexander Blignaut gets low and sweeps this towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shorter ball, quicker this time. Dylan Alexander Blignaut pushes it towards mid-wicket. Dot ball!
Fuller ball, around middle, flatter delivery. Faisal Mubashir knocks it towards long on for a single.
Loopy ball, fuller now, outside off. Dylan Alexander Blignaut sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, on middle. Dylan Alexander Blignaut pushes it towards mid-on. Dot ball.
Shorter ball now, around middle. Faisal Mubashir tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Faisal Mubashir lifts it over towards long off for a single.
Quicker now, and flatter. Faisal Mubashir pushes it towards mid on. Dot ball now!
Quicker now, outside off. Dylan Alexander Blignaut guides it past short third man for a single.
SIX! DISPATCHED! Good aggression from Germany! A fuller ball, slower through the air, outside off. Dylan Alexander Blignaut slog-sweeps this over deep mid-wicket for a biggie!
Fuller ball, around middle and off. Faisal Mubashir reverse-sweeps this towards third man for a single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Faisal Mubashir taps it towards mid-wicket.
SIX! PUNISHED! Much-need six for Germany!  Shorter ball, on middle. Dylan Alexander Blignaut pulls it towards deep square leg for biggie!
fuller, nipping back in, on the pads. Dylan Alexander Blignaut misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.
Craig Young drops it short now, outside off. Dylan Alexander Blignaut looks to pull, but fails to get any connection on it.
Beaten! Good-length delivery, outside off. Dylan Alexander Blignaut looks to push this away but misses.
Tad shorter, around middle and leg. Faisal Mubashir pushes it past square leg for a single.
On a length, around middle and leg. Faisal Mubashir taps it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Craig Young is back on!
Wide of off, fuller in length. Faisal Mubashir steps down and lifts it over towards long off for a single.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Dylan Alexander Blignaut guides it towards third man for a single.
Fuller now, slower this time, outside off. Faisal Mubashir taps it to point and rotates the strike!
Quicker now, fuller, outside off. Dylan Alexander Blignaut pushes it towards third man for single.
Tad shorter, around off. Dylan Alexander Blignaut pushes it towards cover.
Much fuller now, around middle and off. Faisal Mubashir knocks it down to long on for a single.
Full, on middle. Dylan Alexander Blignaut blocks it out.
Slower through the air now, outside off, full in length. Faisal Mubashir pushes it towards long off for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT!  Andy McBrine strikes now! Michael Richardson looks to take him on, but holes out. A fuller ball, on middle. Michael Richardson looks to lift it over long on, but miscues his shot. The ball flies towards Mark Adair at long n who takes it safely. Germany are 3 down now! Dylan Alexander Blignaut is the new man in!
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Adair b Andy McBrine

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller ball, outside off. Faisal Mubashir pushes it towards third man for a single.
Fuller ball, on middle. Faisal Mubashir scoops it towards fine leg for a brace.
Leg bye! Slower through the air, on middle. Michael Richardson leans and tries to block this one, but misses. The ball deflects off the pads and goes towards third man. Leg bye taken!
An appeal for LBW, but not given! A loopy ball, full and on middle Faisal Mubashir looks to block this but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Short again, outside off. Michael Richardson pushes it towards cover for a single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Faisal Mubashir taps it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Leg bye! Tad shorter, around middle. Michael Richardson steps down the wicket and misses. The ball hits the pad and goes towards square leg. Leg bye taken!
Fuller ball, down the leg side. Michael Richardson looks to reverse-sweep but misses.
Loopy ball, very full, on middle. Faisal Mubashir flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Faisal Mubashir taps it towards point for single. Good start from Andy McBrine! 2 runs off his first over!
Tosses this one up, full and on middle. Faisal Mubashir looks to defend but misses and gets rapped on the pads. An appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no!
Loopy ball, full around middle. Michael Richardson reverse-sweep this past short third man fielder for a single.
Slower through the air, around middle. Michael Richardson knocks it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller now, outside off. Michael Richardson pushes it towards cover. Another dot!
A quicker one, shorter, on middle. Michael Richardson taps it towards mid-wicket.
Andy McBrine comes into the attack.
Tad shorter, outside off. Michael Richardson guides it to third man for a single. Germany are 22/2 at the end of the Powerplay.
Fuller ball, outside off. Michael Richardson drives it to the fielder at cover.
On a length, outside off. Michael Richardson looks to cut this away, but gets an inside edge on to the deck.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Another wicket! Josh Little strikes once again and this time he sends back Justin Broad! Good start this for Ireland. A shorter ball, on middle. Justin Broad pulls this one, but the ball goes of the top edge high towards the keeper. Lorcan Tucker keeps his eyes on the ball and takes the catch safely. Germany lose their second wicket now!
Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller ball, outside off. Justin Broad tries to be innovative here, he shuffles across and tries to reverse-scoop this, but misses.
Change of angle for Josh Little! He comes 'round the wicket now, serves a shorter ball, outside off. Michael Richardson taps it towards third man and rotates the strike!
On a length, outside off. Justin Broad taps it towards point.
Good-length delivery, around middle and leg. Michael Richardson works it away past square leg for a single.
Back of a length, around middle. Justin Broad taps it towards square leg for a single.
Shorter ball, around off. Justin Broad pulls and gets an inside edge onto this boot. No run there!
Fuller now, around middle and leg. Justin Broad flicks it past mid-wicket for a brace.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Justin Broad lets that go through to the keeper.
Craig Young comes into the attack.
Length ball, outside off. Michael Richardson leaves it alone. Dot to end the over!
Full in length, outside off. Justin Broad taps it towards third man for a single. The umpire gives Josh Little a warning for running on the danger zone after his follow through.
Tad fuller, outside off. Michael Richardson taps it towards mid off and takes a single. He gets off the mark!
Length ball, outside off. Michael Richardson blocks it out.

OUT! LBW! Josh Little strikes and draws first blood! An early breakthrough for Ireland! On a length, nipping back in, on middle. Talha Khan looks to drive this but misses as the ball comes back in late. He gets hit on the front pad and an appeal for LBW, and the umpire raises his finger. Germany lose their first wicket. Michael Richardson is the man in!
FOUR! Shot! Josh Little serves this in the slot, around middle. Talha Khan heaves this towards mid-wicket for a boundary.
Beaten! Good-length delivery, shaping away from outside off. Justin Broad looks to drive but misses.
Fuller ball, outside off. Talha Khan taps it towards mid off and scampers through to the other end. Single taken!
Good shot! Shorter ball now, on middle. Talha Khan pulls it towards deep square leg. But there is protection there. Two runs taken!
Another length delivery, on the pads. Talha Khan defends it out.
Tad fuller, outside off. Talha Khan pushes it towards cover.
Good-length delivery, nipping back in on middle. Talha Khan misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.
Another beauty! On a length, outside off. Justin Broad once again, looks to block, but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Beaten! Length, outside off. Justin Broad looks to defend but misses.
Fuller length delivery, outside off. Justin Broad pushes it to the fielder at cover. Another dot ball.
Much fuller, wide of off. Justin Broad looks to slash this, but misses.
Fuller ball, around middle. Talha Khan taps it towards mid on for a quick single.
Lenght ball, down the leg side. Talha Khan misses his flick, the ball brushes off his pads.
Another fuller ball, outside off. Justin Broad drives it to the fielder at cover. Dot ball to the end over.
FOUR! Top shot! First boundary! Fuller ball, outside off. Justin Broad drives it past cover for a boundary.
Shorter ball, around the hips. Talha Khan tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller and on middle. Talha Khan pushes it back to the bowler.
Back of a length, outside off. Justin Broad taps it towards point and takes a single. Justin Broad and Germany are up and running.
Mark Adair begins with a shorter ball, shaping away, outside off. Justin Broad looks to push this away but misses. Good start from Mark Adair!

We are set for the game to begin! The players have made their way out to the middle. Justin Broad and Talha Khan will open the batting for Germany. Mark Adair will begin with a new ball. Here we go...

Germany (Playing XI) - Justin Broad, Talha Khan, Michael Richardson (WK), Faisal Mubashir, Dylan Alexander Blignaut, Venkatraman Ganesan (C), Shoaib Azam (In for Vijayshankar Chikkannaiah), Dieter Klein, Fayaz Nasseri, Muslim Ashraf, Ghulam Rasul Ahmadi.
Ireland (Unchanged Playing XI) - Andy Balbirnie (C), Paul Stirling, Gareth Delany, Lorcan Tucker (WK), Harry Tector, George Dockrell, Andy McBrine, Simi Singh, Mark Adair, Craig Young, Josh Little.
TOSS - Ireland have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

Ireland have managed to grab 2 points in two games, they are coming into this game after defeating Bahrain and will be hoping they carry on the same way. Craig Young has been the standout bowler for Ireland he has picked up 5 wickets in two games so far and he proves to be a real threat. Germany, on the other hand, have not been able to get over the line so far. They have lost both their games and now they will have to put their best foot forward to defeat Ireland. Although Ireland seems strong on paper, Germany are well and truly capable of giving them a tough fight. Will Germany cause an upset? We will find out. Stay tuned for the toss and team news.

Hello and a warm welcome to match number 9 of the ICC T20 World Cup Qualifier A, where Ireland will be taking on Germany in their final group stage match. Andy Balbirnie and his men will be eager to come out on top and try to seal a semi-final spot. While Germany will try to get their first win, however, it will be a challenge against the Irish.
... MATCH DAY ...
